objective: Implement the KU2D Data Acquisition v1 target architecture and faster Source Completion operating model in one queue, migrate YouTube Q-Diving into the new contracts as the first reference connector using existing sanitized evidence and fixtures only, and close YouTube at the Minimum Trusted Connection boundary.
queue_purpose_summary: สร้างสถาปัตยกรรมกลางที่ใช้ซ้ำได้ ลดโค้ดและรอบ Queue ต่อ source และใช้ YouTube พิสูจน์ว่า Connector Kit, capability profile, thin adapter, source parser และ Analysis handoff ทำงานครบโดยไม่เรียก provider ซ้ำ

architecture_target.formula: Shared Connector Kit + Domain Capability Profile + Thin Source Adapter + Source-specific Parser + Analysis-owned Semantic Quality
principles: develop each source in an isolated Source Lab before platform integration
reuse proven Technique Library patterns before exploring a new access method
share discovery orchestration, policy, request accounting, evidence, provenance, logging, validation and replay
keep only source-specific access differences in a thin adapter
keep source payload interpretation in a separate source-specific parser
normalize through domain records rather than one universal global source schema
allow different domains and sources to expose different capability sets
promote at Minimum Trusted Connection rather than full capability completeness
hand every technically accepted record to Analysis; Acquisition does not perform semantic selection

requirements: inspect and reuse existing acquisition modules before adding parallel controllers
define stable contracts for lifecycle coordination, request plans, response envelopes, evidence/provenance, request and quota ledger, sanitized logging, error classification and fixture replay
keep provider transport injectable so deterministic fixtures can exercise the complete source path without network access
do not embed source selectors, endpoints, payload parsing or domain semantic quality in the shared kit
create a versioned schema and validator for domain-defined capabilities
support capability states available, partial, unverified, blocked, unsupported and not_applicable with reason and evidence references
do not require Product, Price, Promotion or any universal capability set across domains
define the minimum public-video/Q-Diving profile needed by the YouTube reference source
separate required-for-MTC capabilities from optional capabilities

required_deliverables.component: Source Manifest and Minimum Trusted Connection v1
requirements: create versioned source manifest and MTC assessment contracts
record provider, domain profile, adapter, parser, supported capability states, access surface, known limitations, fixture set, evidence and integration status
MTC requires at least one useful reproducible capability, schema-valid output, provenance, failure classification, sanitized evidence, fixture replay and known limitations
full source capability completeness is not required
adapter declares where and how to access a source, request parameters, pagination interpretation, parser selection and capability declaration
Connector Kit owns execution, secret injection boundary, timeout, retry policy, request/quota accounting, evidence, logging, validation and scheduling boundary
adapter must not write production data, decide semantic quality, create queues, persist secrets or implement a parallel evidence/logging system
thinness is responsibility separation, not an arbitrary line-count limit
parser converts provider responses or fixtures into source-specific records
a separate domain mapper converts source records into domain-normalized records
preserve source-specific fields and provenance without forcing direct conversion to one global schema
parser errors must use shared error classification and evidence contracts
formalize Technique Library reuse -> Explore -> Deep Audit -> Minimum Trusted Connection -> Integration -> Closure
Explore compares existing proven techniques first and uses bounded samples
Deep Audit validates stability, pagination, variants, failure modes, policy, provenance and repeatability of the selected technique
when known techniques fail, permit bounded discovery of a new access method and capture the outcome for later reuse
one Source Completion Queue contains all phases and returns one final Result unless a material Human Gate is reached
reuse KU2D-KP-000003 and acquisition-analysis-handoff.v1 from P51 as authoritative
Acquisition checks technical validity, authority, policy, provenance and sanitization
Analysis owns semantic relevance, quality, ranking, analytical deduplication/grouping and final inclusion
no per-record Human semantic gate exists in Acquisition
document one Source Completion Queue per source with internal phases and one closure Result
Codex self-corrects technical issues inside the queue and does not return for syntax, fixture, parser, schema, evidence or CI issues that remain within scope
Assistant reviews the final Result and material evidence rather than every internal checkpoint
Human confirmation remains only for legal/policy ambiguity, restricted or personal data, material scope/quota expansion, new spending, production write or elevated authority
record a short queue-purpose summary whenever a new Queue is opened
preserve the commands Continue from KU2D queue and ต่อครับ as the standard handoff

level_1_self_correction.frequency: after each material correction affecting the relevant component

level_2_before_pr.requirement: must pass for every affected reference source before PR creation

level_3_before_merge_or_closure.requirement: run once on the exact PR head after all code and journal commit references are final
level_3_before_merge_or_closure.rerun_condition: any code, schema, fixture, policy or test input changes after the exact-head run
level_3_before_merge_or_closure.reuse_condition: the merge tree is proven identical to the exact tested PR-head tree

technical_correction_policy.capture_timing: immediately after each materially distinct correction in a local sanitized journal
technical_correction_policy.commit_rule: pending_commit is allowed during correction but every event must reference the final related commit before PR creation or queue closure
noise_exclusions: duplicate symptoms of one root cause
format-only actions with no material technical effect

instructions: wrap or migrate the existing validated YouTube discovery implementation into the new adapter/parser/domain contracts without rewriting immutable evidence
derive deterministic adapter and parser fixtures only from already sanitized committed evidence; do not retrieve raw provider payloads or workflow logs
prove the existing ten candidates remain retrievable through KU2D-AI-000001
produce a YouTube source manifest, public-video domain capability profile and MTC assessment
close YouTube v1 when video_metadata and channel_identity meet MTC; do not hold closure for comments, captions, transcripts, semantic quality or production scheduling

tiktok_readiness_boundary.expected_followup: After Assistant accepts R52 and YouTube v1 is closed, create a separate TikTok Source Completion Queue using the new operating model.

instructions: Inspect the current integration implementation and existing technique, experience, evidence, logging, validation and correction modules before editing. Extend authoritative modules rather than creating competing wrappers.
Implement the smallest coherent v1 foundation needed for the next source; do not attempt production-complete infrastructure or speculative capabilities.
Keep all changes inside P52. Do not create P53, intermediate Prompt/Result/Review records, or separate PRs for corrections.
Use targeted level-1 tests during self-correction, level-2 source integration and evidence validation before PR, and one exact-head level-3 full deterministic corpus before merge/closure.
Create and finalize KU2D-CJ-000002. If no material correction occurs, submit a valid zero-event journal rather than inventing events.
Create one Ready PR to integration/data-acquisition-platform after level-2 passes. Require clean scope, exact head and applicable CI, then merge under H21 when technically green.
Verify the merge tree is identical to the tested exact PR-head tree or rerun the full corpus on the final tree.

Submit only KU2D-R-000052 with architecture deliverables, changed files, correction journal, test evidence by level, PR/CI/merge metadata, provider request/quota counts, YouTube MTC assessment and explicit YouTube closure status.
stop_conditions: implementation requires a provider request, P50/P51 replay or additional quota
implementation requires raw provider payload retrieval, workflow log retrieval, comments, captions, transcripts, restricted or personal data
implementation requires production write, scheduling, new spending or elevated authority
a capability or adapter contract would discard immutable candidate records or provenance
the architecture cannot be implemented without rewriting immutable historical records
repository permission or protected-branch policy blocks the authorized integration merge
a material scope change beyond the agreed v1 architecture is necessary

Domain Capability Profile, Source Manifest and MTC schemas/validators exist
Thin Adapter, Source Parser and domain mapper responsibilities are enforced by contracts and tests
Source Lab and Chat-to-Codex operating procedures are documented and validated where deterministic validation is applicable
three-tier testing policy is documented and followed in R52 evidence
KU2D-CJ-000002 preserves every material correction without PR-per-correction
one coherent exact-head PR is merged to integration/data-acquisition-platform
full deterministic corpus passes on the exact final tree
YouTube video_metadata and channel_identity pass MTC using existing sanitized evidence and fixtures only
all ten YouTube candidates remain retrievable and Analysis-owned semantic fields remain unassessed
YouTube v1 is closed without comments, captions, transcripts, provider replay, production write or scheduling
TikTok is not executed and is ready to start later as a separate Source Completion Queue
KU2D-R-000052 is submitted for Assistant review
